en: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration. — Thomas Edison
zh: 天才是百分之一的靈感，加上百分之九十九的努力。— 湯瑪斯．愛迪生

en: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn. — Benjamin Franklin
zh: 告訴我知識，我會忘記；教導我知識，我只會記得；讓我深入其中，我才真正學到知識且能夠運用。— 班傑明‧富蘭克林

en: A pessimist is one who makes difficulties of his opportunities and an optimist is one who makes opportunities of his difficulties. — Harry S. Truman
zh: 悲觀者把機會視為困難，樂觀者把困難轉化為機會。— 哈瑞．杜魯門

en: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else. — Margaret Mead
zh: 別忘了你是獨一無二的，其他人也是一樣。— 瑪格麗特．米德

en: An unexamined life is not worth living. — Socrates
zh: 未受檢驗的生活不值得過。— 蘇格拉底

en: Challenges are what make life interesting and overcoming them is what makes life meaningful. — Joshua J. Marine
zh: 生命的趣味在於挑戰，而生命的意義在於超越挑戰。— 約書亞．馬里恩

en: Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant. — Robert Louis Stevenson
zh: 不要以所得的收穫，而是以所撒的種子來評斷你的每一天。— 羅伯特．路易斯．史蒂文森

en: Education is not the filling of a pail but the lighting of a fire. — William Butler Yeats
zh: 教育不是注滿一桶水，而且點燃一把火。— 葉慈

en: Every man is a poet when he is in love. — Plato
zh: 每個戀愛中的人都是詩人。 — 柏拉圖

en: Genius only means hard-working all one's life. — Mendeleyev
zh: 天才只意味著終身不懈地努力。 — 門得列夫

en: Happiness lies not in the mere possession of money; it lies in the joy of achievement, in the thrill of creative effort. — Franklin Roosevelt
zh: 幸福不在於擁有金錢，而在於獲得成就時的喜悅以及產生創造力的激情。 — 富蘭克林．羅斯福

en: I am a slow walker, but I never walk backwards. — Abraham Lincoln
zh: 我走得很慢，但是我從來不會後退。— 亞伯拉罕．林肯

en: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination. — Jimmy Dean
zh: 我不能改變風向，但我可以調整風帆，讓我總是可以往目的地前進。— 吉米．迪恩

en: I didn't fail the test. I just found 100 ways to do it wrong. — Benjamin Franklin
zh: 我並不是沒考好，只是找到另外一百種答題的方式。— 班傑明．富蘭克林

en: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it. — Voltaire
zh: 我不同意你說的話，但是我願意誓死捍衛你說話的權利。 — 伏爾泰

en: If I looked compared to others far, is because I stand on giant's shoulder. — Newton
zh: 如果我看得比別人遠，是因為我站在巨人的肩膀上。— 牛頓

en: If you can't fly, then run; if you can't run, then walk; if you can't walk, then crawl; but whatever you do, you have to keep moving forward. — Martin Luther King
zh: 不能飛就用跑的，不能跑就用走的，不能走就用爬的，但不管你做什麼，你必須持續往前。— 馬丁．路德

en: If you don't like something, change it; if you can't change it, change the way you think about it. — Mary Engelbreit
zh: 如果你不喜歡某件事情，那就改變它；如果你無法改變它，那麼就改變你對這件事情的看法。— 瑪莉．恩格爾布雷

en: If you have no critics, you will likely have no success. — Malcolm S. Forbes
zh: 如果沒有批評你的人，你就不太可能會成功。— 馬康．富比士

en: If you judge people, you have no time to love them. — Mother Teresa
zh: 如果你論斷他人，你就沒有時間愛他們了。 — 德蕾莎修女

en: If you look at what you have in life, you'll always have more. If you look at what you don't have in life, you'll never have enough. — Oprah Winfrey
zh: 如果你只看你擁有的，你將擁有的更多；如果你只看你沒有的，你將永遠不滿足。— 歐普拉．溫芙蕾

en: Imagination is more important than knowledge. — Albert Einstein
zh: 想像力比知識更為重要。 — 愛因斯坦

en: Intelligence plus character – that is the goal of real education. —Martin Luther King
zh: 智慧加上品格才是教育真正的目標。— 馬丁 · 路德

en: It is not how much you do, but how much love you put into the doing that matters. — Mother Teresa
zh: 重點不是你做了多少事，而是你對於所做的事付出了多少愛。— 德雷莎修女

en: Knowledge is a treasure, but practice is the key to it. — British churchman Thomas Fuller
zh: 知識是一座寶庫，而實踐是開啟寶庫的鑰匙。— 托馬斯．富勒

en: Knowledge is power. — Francis Bacon
zh: 知識就是力量。 — 法蘭西斯．培根

en: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving. — Albert Einstein
zh: 人生就像騎自行車，為了讓自己保持平衡，你必須持續向前邁進。— 愛因斯坦

en: Living without an aim is like sailing without a compass. — Alexandre Dumas
zh: 生活沒有目標就像航海沒有指南針。— 大仲馬

en: Love the life you live. Live the life you love. — Bob Marley
zh: 喜愛自己過的生活，過自己喜愛的生活。— 巴布．馬利

en: Love well, whip well. — Benjamin Franklin
zh: 愛之深，責之切。— 班傑明．富蘭克林

en: Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and then beat you with experience. — Mark Twain
zh: 絕對不要和愚笨的人爭論，他們會把你拉至他們的層次，然後憑經驗擊敗你。— 馬克．吐溫

en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts. — Winston Churchill
zh: 成功不是結局，失敗也非末日，堅持努力不懈的勇氣，才最重要。— 邱吉爾

en: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched. They must be felt with the heart. — Helen Keller
zh: 世界上最棒和最美好的事物是看不見也摸不著的，必須要用心去感受。— 海倫．凱勒

en: The first wealth is health. — Ralph Waldo Emerson
zh: 健康是人生的第一財富。— 愛默生

en: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall. — Nelson Mandela
zh: 生活最大的榮耀不在於從未跌倒，而是每次跌倒後再站起來。— 納爾遜．曼德拉

en: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself. — Franklin Roosevelt
zh: 唯一需要我們恐懼的就是恐懼本身。— 羅斯福

en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle. — Steve Jobs
zh: 成就的唯一途徑是熱愛自己的事業，如果你還沒找到的話，繼續尋找，不要屈就。— 賈伯斯

en: The ordinary focus on what they're getting. The extraordinary think about who they're becoming. — Robin Sharma
zh: 普通的人專注於得到什麼，傑出的人專注於成為什麼樣的人。— 羅賓．夏瑪

en: The past cannot be changed. The future is yet in your power. — Mary Pickford
zh: 歷史無法改變，但未來仍在你的掌握中。— 瑪麗．畢克馥

en: The purpose of our lives is to be happy. — Dalai Lama
zh: 我們生活的目的在於幸福。— 達賴喇嘛

en: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing. — Walt Disney
zh: 開始一件事的方法，就是停止說話並起身去做。— 華特．迪士尼

en: There are seven things that will destroy us: wealth without work; pleasure without conscience; knowledge without character; religion without sacrifice; politics without principle; science without humanity; business without ethics. — Mahatma Gandhi
zh: 七件事可以造成毀滅：有財富沒有努力；有快樂沒有良知；有知識沒有品格；有信仰沒有犧牲；有政治沒有原則；有科學沒有人性；有商業沒有道德。— 甘地

en: Those who dare to fail miserably can achieve greatly. — John F. Kennedy
zh: 不怕慘敗，才能有偉大的成就。— 約翰．甘迺迪

en: Try not to become a man of success but rather try to become a man of value. — Albert Einstein
zh: 不要為成功而努力，要為做一個有價值的人而努力。— 愛因斯坦

en: Until we can manage time, we can manage nothing else. — Peter F. Drucker
zh: 在我們能管理時間以前，我們無法管理其他的東西。— 彼得．杜拉克

en: We must accept finite disappointment, but we must never lose infinite hope. — Martin Luther King
zh: 我們必須接受失望，因為它是有限的，但千萬不可失去希望，因為它是無窮的。— 馬丁．路德

en: When the whole world is silent, even one voice becomes powerful. — Malala
zh: 當整個世界都沉默時，即使一個聲音也會變得很有力量。— 馬拉拉

en: When we are saying this cannot be accomplished, this cannot be done, then we are short-changing ourselves. My brain, it cannot process failure. It will not process failure. — Kobe Bryant
zh: 當我們說一件事無法完成、一件事做不到，我們就是在虧待自己。我的大腦無法處理失敗，它不會去處理失敗。— 柯比．布萊恩

en: Where there is a will, there is a way. — Thomas Edison
zh: 有志者，事竟成。— 湯瑪斯．愛迪生

en: You have to believe in yourself. That's the secret of success. — Charles Chaplin
zh: 你必須相信自己，這就是成功的秘訣。 — 卓別林

en: You must be the change you want to see in the world. — Gandhi
zh: 你必須成為這個世界上你希望看到的改變。— 甘地

en: No cross, no crown.
zh: 不經歷風雨，怎麼遇見彩虹。

en: Sometime ever, sometime never.
zh: 相聚有時，後會無期。

en: In the dull and boring world, there is also occasional luck.
zh: 枯燥無味的世界，總會有小確幸。

en: Treat yourself well.
zh: 善待你自己。

en: No fear of words, no fear of years.
zh: 不懼人言，不畏歲月。

en: Don't let the past steal your present.
zh: 只要開始，雖晚不遲。

en: Better late than never.
zh: 別讓過去悄悄偷走了你的當下。

en: Stars can't shine without darkness.
zh: 如果沒有黑暗，星星如何閃耀。

en: Be cheerful and hopeful.
zh: 樂觀向上，充滿希望。

en: Have the ability to love oneself, have the strength to love others.
zh: 有能力愛自己，有餘力愛別人

en: Spend your life in your own way.
zh: 用自己喜歡的方式過一生。

en: Life is short and you deserve to be happy.
zh: 生命苦短，你應該過的開心點。

en: Time is that we do not come loose.
zh: 時光不老，我們不散。

en: You can't be perfect but you can be unique.
zh: 你不能十全十美，但你能獨一無二。

en: You don't have time to be timid.
zh: 人生沒有時間膽怯。

en: It's up to you how far you'll go.
zh: 能走多遠取決於你自己。

en: To laugh at yourself is to love yourself.
zh: 學會自嘲也是愛自己的一種表現。

en: Make each day your masterpiece.
zh: 讓每一天成為你的傑作。

en: Travel far enough you meet yourself.
zh: 走得足夠遠，你就會遇上自己。

en: Above all, don't lie to yourself.
zh: 最重要的是不要欺騙自己。

en: Light tomorrow with today.
zh: 用現在點亮未來。

en: Don't compare your life with others. There's no comparison between the sun and the moon. They shine when it's their time.
zh: 別拿你的人生和別人的比較。太陽和月亮沒有可比性。它們都在屬於自己的時刻發光。

en: I am not afraid of tomorrow for I have seen yesterday and love today.
zh: 我不害怕明天，因為我經歷過昨天，也熱愛今天。

en: Give free to him when you fall in love and give free to love when you don't love.
zh: 愛的時候，讓他自由；不愛的時候，讓愛自由。

en: The greatest test of courage on earth is to bear defeat without losing heart.
zh: 世界上對勇氣的最大考驗是忍受失敗而不喪失信心。

en: A man's best friends are his ten fingers.
zh: 人最好的朋友是自己的十個手指。(靠自己最實在)

en: Only they who fulfill their duties in everyday matters will fulfill them on great occasions.
zh: 只有在日常生活中盡責的人才會在重大時刻盡責。

en: The shortest way to do many things is to only one thing at a time.
zh: 做許多事情的捷徑就是一次只做一件事。

en: All things in their being are good for something.
zh: 天生我才必有用。

en: There's only one corner of the universe you can be sure of improving, and that's your own self.
zh: 這個宇宙中只有一個角落你肯定可以改進，那就是你自己。

en: Difficult circumstances serve as a textbook of life for people.
zh: 困難坎坷是人們的生活教科書。

en: The world is like a mirror: Frown at it and it frowns at you; smile, and it smiles too.
zh: 世界猶如一面鏡子：朝它皺眉它就朝你皺眉，朝它微笑它也朝你微笑。

en: Failure is the mother of success.
zh: 失敗乃成功之母。

en: The reason why a great man is great is that he resolves to be a great man.
zh: 偉人之所以偉大，是因為他立志要成為偉大的人。

en: Journey of a thousand miles begins with single step.
zh: 千里之行，始於足下。

en: The first step is as good as half over.
zh: 第一步是最關鍵的一步。

en: Genius is an infinite capacity for taking pains.
zh: 所謂的天才是不斷地承受痛楚。

en: A man is only as good as what he loves.
zh: 一個人要用他所愛的東西有多好來衡量。

en: I know that my future is not just a dream.
zh: 我知道我的未來不是夢。

en: Energy and persistent conquer all things.
zh: 能量和堅持可以克服一切。

en: I will greet this day with love in my heart.
zh: 我要用全心的愛來迎接今天。

en: The good seaman is known in bad weather.
zh: 驚濤駭浪，方顯英雄本色。

en: Quitters never win and winners never quit.
zh: 退縮者永無勝利，勝利者永不退縮

en: You're unique, nothing can replace you.
zh: 你舉世無雙，無人可以替代。

en: Understand yourself in order to better understanding others.
zh: 知己方能解人。

en: Better to light one candle than to curse the darkness.
zh: 與其詛咒黑暗，不如燃起蠟燭。

en: Victory won't come to me unless I go to it.
zh: 勝利是不會向我們走來的，我必須自己走向勝利。

en: Don't worry about the vague future, just strive for the clear present.
zh: 不為模糊不清的未來擔憂，只為清清楚楚的現在努力。

en: The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today.
zh: 對明天做好的準備就是今天做到最好！

en: Knowledge can change your fate and English can accomplish your future.
zh: 知識改變命運，英文成就未來。

en: A man is not old until regrets take the place of dreams.
zh: 當後悔取代了夢想，一個人才算老了。

en: Don't let a little dispute break up a great friendship.
zh: 不要讓小小的爭端損毀了一場偉大的友誼。

en: Better to do something imperfectly than to do nothing flawlessly.
zh: 寧願做事不完美，總比完美地不做事要好。

en: Actually it is just in an idea when feel oneself can achieve and cannot achieve.
zh: 覺得自己做得到和做不到，往往只在一念之間。

en: While there is life there is hope.
zh: 一息若存，希望不滅。

en: Being yourself is an honor, because nobody else can be you.
zh: 做自己是一種榮耀，因為沒有任何人能成為你。

en: I can make it through the rain. I can stand up once again on my own.
zh: 我可以穿越雲雨，也可以東山再起。

en: There are so many beautiful reasons to be happy.
zh: 有太多太多美好的理由讓你笑對生活。

en: Whether you fail or fly, at least you tried.
zh: 不管是一飛沖天還是跌入穀底，至少，你嘗試過。

en: Time waits for no one. Treasure every moment you have.
zh: 時間不等人，珍惜你所擁有的每分每秒吧

en: Being entirely honest with oneself is a good exercise.
zh: 對自己完全誠實是很好的練習。

en: Pessimism leads to weakness, optimism to power.
zh: 悲觀導致軟弱，樂觀導致力量。

en: You make a life out of what you have, not what you're missing.
zh: 靠自己所擁有的，而不是所缺少的，來過你的人生。

en: People are lonely because they build walls instead of bridges.
zh: 人類會寂寞是因為他們建了牆壁而不是橋樑。

en: Clear thinking requires courage rather than intelligence.
zh: 思路清楚需要的是勇氣而不是智力。

en: Inside of every problem lies an opportunity.
zh: 每個問題裡都藏著一個機會。

en: If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.
zh: 如果你仔細觀察，大部分的一夕成功都花很長一段時間。

en: You must expect great things of yourself before you can do them.
zh: 你必須先見到很棒的自己，才能做出很棒的事。

en: You had me at "hello".
zh: 第一眼見到你時，我就被你征服了。

en: You complete me.
zh: 你使我人生完整。

en: You are the best thing I never planned.
zh: 你是我最美好的意外。

en: There are two reasons why I wake up in the morning: my alarm clock and you.
zh: 我早上願意醒來為兩個理由: 鬧鐘和你。

en: Being with you has made me so lame. I think I like it.
zh: 跟你在一起讓我變得很廢。不過我喜歡。

en: Sorry, I got loss in your eyes again.
zh: 不好意思，我又再次迷失在你的眼裡。

en: To the world you may be just one person. To the person you may be the world.
zh: 對這世界來說，你也許只是某個人；但對某個人來說，你卻是全世界。

en: If I know what love is, it is because of you.
zh: 因為你，我懂得了愛。

en: I'll think of you every step of the way.
zh: 我會想你，在漫漫長路的每一步。

en: Passionate love is a quenchless thirst.
zh: 熱烈的愛情是不可抑制的渴望。

en: At the touch of love everyone becomes a poet.
zh: 每一個沐浴在愛河中的人都是詩人。

en: Love is a vine that grows into our hearts.
zh: 愛是長在我們心裏的藤蔓。

en: It is impossible to love and to be wise.
zh: 要愛又兼有理性是不可能的。

en: Faults are sick when love is thin.
zh: 一朝情義淡，樣樣不順眼。

en: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
zh: 生命如花，愛情是蜜。

en: The road to a lover's house is never long.
zh: 通往愛人家裏的路總不會漫長。

en: Love is hard to get into, but harder to get out of.
zh: 愛很難投入，但一旦投入，便更難走出。

en: Love is not only a sentiment but also an art.
zh: 愛情不僅僅是感情，它也是藝術。

en: Love is like the moon, when it does not increase, it decreases.
zh: 愛情就像月亮，不增則減。

en: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
zh: 愛情跟咳嗽一樣是掩飾不了的。

en: Love me little and love me long.
zh: 不求情意綿綿，但求天長地久。

en: Being with you is like walking on a very clear morning.
zh: 和你在一起就像在一個清爽的早晨漫步。

en: It is never too late to fall in love.
zh: 愛永遠不會嫌晚。

en: There is no hiding from lover's eyes.
zh: 什麼也瞞不過戀人的眼睛。

en: In love folly is always sweet.
zh: 戀愛中，幹傻事總是讓人感到十分美妙。

en: In the very smallest cot there is room enough for a loving pair.
zh: 哪怕是最小的茅屋，對情人來說都有足夠的空間。

en: Don't try so hard, the best things come when you least expect them.
zh: 不要著急，最好的總會在最不經意的時候出現。

en: You are everything when you are with me, and everything is you when you are not.
zh: 跟你在一起時，你是一切，你不在時，一切是你！

en: If i could rearrange the alphabet, i'd put y and i together.
zh: 如果我能重新來排列字母，我要把y（你）跟i（我）在一起。

en: Love is not a matter of counting the days. It's making the days count.
zh: 愛情不是數着日子過去，它讓每個日子都變得有意義。

en: Love you so i don't wanna go to sleep, for reality is better than a dream.
zh: 愛你，所以不想入睡，因為真實比夢境還要美麗。

en: There is no remedy for love but to love more.
zh: 治療愛的創傷，唯有加倍地去愛。

en: No words are necessary between two loving hearts.
zh: 兩顆相愛的心之間不需要言語。

en: The darkness is no darkness with you.
zh: 有了你，黑暗不再是黑暗。

en: She who has never loved, has never lived.
zh: 人活著總要愛一回。

en: Every day without you is like a book without pages.
zh: 沒有你的日子就像一本沒有書頁的書。

en: If the while I think on you, all losses are restored, and sorrows end.
zh: 只要我一想起你，所有的失落和遺憾煙消雲散。

en: Before meeting you, I indulge in the past. After meeting you, I plan to spend the rest of my life.
zh: 遇見你之前，我沉迷過往；遇見你以後，我盤算餘生。

en: I want that my love to you will turn into bright sunlight so that to warm your heart.
zh: 我想將對你的感情化作暖暖的陽光，期待那灑落的光明能溫暖你的心房。

en: I miss you so much already and I haven't even left yet!
zh: 儘管還不曾離開，我已對你朝思暮想！

en: Tell me you are mine. I'll be yours through all the years, till the end of time.
zh: 請告訴我你是我的。歲歲年年，我都屬於你，永遠永遠。

en: I need you like i need the air to breathe.
zh: 我需要你，正如我需要呼吸空氣。

en: The best love is probably, I make your heart move you make me feel at ease.
zh: 最好的愛情大概是：我讓你心動，你讓我心安。

en: You protect the world, I protect you.
zh: 你保護世界，我保護你。

en: I am fortunate to meet you in such a big world.
zh: 世界很大，難得的是遇到了你。

en: Every single person has at least one secret that would break your heart.
zh: 每個單身的人背後，至少藏著一個讓人心碎的秘密。

en: It's a good thing to like someone.
zh: 喜歡上某人，是一件美好事情。

en: I will be better, because of you, but not for you.
zh: 我會變得更好，是因為你，但不是為了你。

en: We're best mates. He makes me laugh every day.
zh: 我們是最棒的伴侶，他每天都可以讓我笑。

en: I see no reason to wait. When you know it's right, it's right.
zh: 我沒有看到任何需要等待的理由，當你覺得時間對了，那就是對的。

en: Someone who wants to be with you, will be with you.
zh: 真心想跟你在一起支持你的人，就永遠會陪著你！

en: Whatever happens tomorrow, we had today. I'll always remember it.
zh: 無論明天發生什麼事，至少我們擁有當下。

en: Affection is when you see someone's strength; love is when you accept someone's flaws.
zh: 喜歡，是看到一個人的優點；愛，是接受一個人的缺點。

en: If you would be loved, love and be lovable.
zh: 想被人愛，就要去愛別人，並讓自己可愛。

en: Anything you want me to do, I remember, you remember.
zh: 你要帶我做的任何事，我都記得，你也記得。

en: The two most beautiful things are: sleep with you.
zh: 最美好的兩件事是：睡覺和你，簡稱睡你。

en: Some people can not tell where good, but who can not be replaced.
zh: 有些人說不清哪裡好，但就是誰也替代不了。

en: Hold your hand and don't let it go.
zh: 抓住了手就別放，愛對了人就走下去。

en: Always have, always will.
zh: 一直愛你，始終如一。

en: It's Okay to not to be Okay.
zh: 不太好也沒關係。

en: All grown-ups were once children.
zh: 所有的大人，都曾經是孩子。

en: Take you time.
zh: 不急，慢慢來。

en: Travel far enough, you would meet yourself.
zh: 走個夠遠，就會遇到自己。

en: I am a happy-go-lucky kind of guy.
zh: 我是一個樂天派。

en: Keep your shirt on.
zh: 冷靜點，別急。

en: Time will tell.
zh: 時間會證明的。

en: Go ahead, make my day.
zh: 加油，讓自己開心！

en: May the force be with you.
zh: 力量與你同在。

en: If you aim at the moon, even if you are lost, you will fall between the stars.
zh: 如果你瞄準月亮，即使迷失了，你仍會落在星河之間。

en: You can't please everyone.
zh: 你不可能取悅所有人。

en: Think nothing of it.
zh: 別放在心上。

en: Destiny takes a hand.
zh: 命中注定。

en: Swim against the stream.
zh: 逆流而上。

en: Make each day count.
zh: 讓每天都活得值得。

en: No looking back, only forward.
zh: 別回頭，往前看。

en: Let it go.
zh: 放手讓它去吧。

en: A laugh can be a very powerful thing.
zh: 笑容是個有力量的東西。

en: Beauty is found within.
zh: 美，是由內而外散發出的。

en: You are braver than you believe.
zh: 你比你以為的更勇敢。

en: Here's the whole word at your feet.
zh: 全世界都在你的腳下。

en: All it takes is faith and trust.
zh: 信念與信任，缺一不可。

en: If you don't try, you'll never know.
zh: 如果不嘗試，你永遠不會知道結果。

en: A goal without a plan is just a wish.
zh: 沒有計劃的目標，就只是個願望罷了。

en: Fake friends never betray in front of you. They always do it behind you.
zh: 假朋友從不會當面背叛你，都是背後。

en: Actually I wanted to say on that day, shall we never get apart, OK?
zh: 其實，那天我想說的是，“我們永遠不要分開了好不好？”

en: God helps those who help themselves.
zh: 天助自助者。

en: Without you, my life don't know how to describe.
zh: 沒有你，我的生活不知道該怎樣去形容。

en: First I need your hand, then forever can begin.
zh: 我需要牽著你的手，才能告訴你什麼是永遠

en: Forget others' faults by remembering your own.
zh: 想想自己的錯，會忘卻別人的過。

en: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times.
zh: 即使在最黑暗的日子裡，也能尋到幸福。

en: Don't judge someone's past, when you haven't walked their journey!
zh: 如果你沒有經歷過別人所經歷的事情，就不要去評判一個人的過去！

en: Fading is true while flowering is past.
zh: 凋謝是真實的，盛開只是一種過去

en: Fallen into the trap, for you are too greedy, it's not because of others cunning.
zh: 會上當，不是因為別人太狡猾，而是因為自己太貪。

en: All or nothing, now or never.
zh: 要麼沒有，要麼全部。要麼現在，要麼永不。

en: Great hopes make great man.
zh: 偉大的理想造就偉大的人。

en: We are all too young, a lot of things don't yet know, don't put the.
zh: 我們都太年輕，很多事都還不了解，別把錯愛當恩寵。

en: Honestly, if you are not willing to sound stupid, you don't deserve to be in love.
zh: 坦白說，如果你不打算為愛做點傻事，你就不配擁有愛。

en: If someone truly loves you, distance is not a problem. It's just the power of making love grow each day.
zh: 如果一個人真的愛你，距離不是一個問題，它只會成為一種滋長愛情的力量。

en: If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude. Don't complain.
zh: 如果你不喜歡某件事，就改變它；如果你不能改變它，就改變你的態度。不要抱怨。

en: I don't know what to say, I'm just thinking of you a lot at this moment.
zh: 我不知道該說什麼，我只是突然在這一刻，很想你。

en: I prefer having your accompanying for life-long time to the short-time tenderness.
zh: 我要的，不只是短暫的溫柔。

en: If you want something you've never had, then you've got to do something you've never done.
zh: 如果你想擁有你從未有過的東西，那麼你必須去做你從未做過的事情。

en: In the past, I only wanted people to see the best of me. Now, I find that I do not mind you seeing my faults because I want you to accept me the way I am.
zh: 以往，我只在人前呈現出最好的一面。如今我不介意你看到我的缺點，因為我希望你接受的，是一個完整的我。

en: I'm thankful to all those who said 'NO'. because of them, I did it myself.
zh: 感謝那些曾經對我說 '不' 的人，正因為他們，我靠我自己做到了。

en: I know I'm not beautiful, but everyday I hope you think that I am.
zh: 我知道我不夠美，但每天我都期望著你會覺得我是美麗的。

en: For those things I don't talk about, it does not mean i don't know.
zh: 有些事不說，不代表不知道。

en: Adversity does teach who your real friends are.
zh: 經歷逆境會讓你知道誰是真正的朋友。

en: Just like a shoe, if someone is meant for you, they will fit perfectly; no forcing, no struggling, no pain.
zh: 就像一雙鞋，如果他是屬於你的，他就會百分之百的適合你；沒有強迫，沒有掙扎，沒有痛苦。

en: Forgetting someone doesn't mean never think of him, but thinking of him with a calm heart.
zh: 忘記一個人，並非不再想起，而是偶爾想起，心中卻不再有波瀾

en: From small beginning come great things.
zh: 偉大始於渺小。

en: Gentle to have, but not compromise, I want to be in quiet, not strong.
zh: 溫柔要有，但不是妥協，我要在安靜中，不慌不忙的堅強。

en: I hope you are here for me.
zh: 我希望你為我而來。

en: Around the galaxy, there are no brighter starts than you.
zh: 環游遍了整個星系，找不到比你更亮的星星

en: May you be faithful to yourself, live earnestly and laugh freely.
zh: 願你忠於自己，活的認真，笑的放肆

en: You are as warm as the sunset glow.
zh: 你與日落晚霞同樣溫暖。

en: If you can't live longer, live deeper.
zh: 如果你不能活得長久，那就讓生命變得更有深度。

en: Be fearless.
zh: 無所畏懼。

en: Everything Happens for a Reason.
zh: 事出有因。

en: As long as we're happy, that's all that matters.
zh: 只要現在是開心的，這就足夠了。

en: Life does not have to be perfect to be wonderful.
zh: 精彩的人生不必苛求完美。

en: Live beautifully, dream passionately, love completely.
zh: 活要活得美好，夢要夢得熱烈，愛要愛得完整。

en: Life is too short for us to wake up in the morning with regrets.
zh: 人生苦短，所以每天不要帶著遺憾醒來。

en: Crouch down, hold your knees when you are depressed. Forgive others and yourself.
zh: 憂鬱的時候蹲下來抱抱自己，原諒別人，也原諒自己。

en: Doing what you like is freedom. Liking what you do is happiness.
zh: 自由是做你喜歡做的事，幸福是喜歡你做的事。

en: Don't wait to be lonely, to recognize the value of a friend.
zh: 不要等到孤獨了，才明白朋友的價值。

en: Follow your heart, but be quiet for a while first. Learn to trust your heart.
zh: 跟著感覺走，靜靜地。學著去相信自己的內心。

en: Memory is a wonderful thing if you don't have to deal with the past.
zh: 回憶是美好的，只要你能讓過去的都過去。

en: Be nice to people on the way up, because you'll need them on your way down.
zh: 向上爬時，對遇到的人好點，因為掉下來時，你還會遇到他們。

en: A bad excuse is worse than none.
zh: 糟糕的藉口還不如沒有。

en: A bird in hand is worth two in the bush.
zh: 一鳥在手勝於二鳥在林。

en: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
zh: 知足常樂。

en: A good medicine tastes bitter.
zh: 良藥苦口利於病，忠言逆耳利於行。

en: Better be the head of a dog than the tail of a lion.
zh: 寧為雞首，勿為牛後。

en: Do nothing you would wish to conceal.
zh: 若要人不知，除非己莫為。

en: Experience is the best teacher.
zh: 經驗是良師。

en: Many a little makes a mackle.
zh: 積少成多。

en: It is easier to get than to keep it.
zh: 創業容易守成難。

en: Look before you leap.
zh: 三思而後行。

en: Practice makes perfect.
zh: 熟能生巧。

en: Prevention is better than cure.
zh: 預防勝於治療。

en: Rome was not built in a day.
zh: 羅馬不是一天造成的。

en: Do what you say, say what you do.
zh: 做你說過的，說你能做的。

en: There is a difference between knowing the path and walking the path.
zh: 知道和做到是兩件事。

en: Life is 10 percent what happens to me and 90 percent how I react to it.
zh: 看待事情的態度幾乎決定了你將過怎麼樣的人生。

en: Bare words, no bargain.
zh: 空言不能成交易。

en: I love you not because of who you are, but because of who I am when I am with you.
zh: 我愛你，不是因為你是一個怎樣的人，而是因為我喜歡與你在一起時的感覺。

en: I thought love that comes in time is the best love, but it is not a patch on your love at first sight.
zh: 我以為日久生情是最美好的愛情，可卻抵不過你的一見鍾情。

en: Every time I see you, I fall in love all over again.
zh: 每見到你一次，我就又愛上你一次。

en: Our relationship is meant to be.
zh: 我們的關係是命中註定。

en: All love is secret, all soulful only for you.
zh: 所有深愛都是秘密，所有深情都只為你。

en: I love you for all that you are, all that you have been, and all you're yet to be.
zh: 我愛你的全部，包含當下、曾經以及未來的你。

en: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
zh: 今天要做一些未來的你會感謝自己的事。

en: Sweat is the lubricant of success.
zh: 汗水是成功的潤滑劑。

en: Every noble work is at first impossible.
zh: 每一個偉大的工程最初看起來都是不可能做到的！

en: In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
zh: 每個困境中都充滿著機會。

en: The best revenge is massive success.
zh: 最佳的報復是巨大的成功。

en: Opportunities don't happen; you create them.
zh: 機會不會自己出現，你要創造它們。

en: Life has no limitations, except the ones you make.
zh: 人生沒有極限，除了你自己設下的限制以外。

en: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
zh: 未來是屬於那些相信自己美好夢想的人。

en: Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
zh: 別讓你不擅長的事阻礙了你擅長的事。

en: Great minds have purpose; others have wishes.
zh: 傑出的人有著目標，其他人只有願望。

en: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day-in and day-out.
zh: 成功是由很多每天不斷重複的小努力組成的。

en: All progress takes place outside the comfort zone.
zh: 所有的成長都是發生在舒適圈之外。

en: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
zh: 相信你可以，你就已經成功一半了。

en: Winners never quit, and quitters never win.
zh: 贏家永遠不會放棄，放棄者永遠不會贏。

en: If you really want to do something, you'll find a way. If you don't, you'll find an excuse.
zh: 如果你真的很想做一件事，你就會找到方法；如果你不是很想，你就會找到藉口。

en: Success is the ability to go from one failure to another with no loss of enthusiasm.
zh: 成功是，你即使跨過一個又一個失敗，但也沒有失去熱情。

en: Character is how you treat those who can do nothing for you.
zh: 品格取決於：你如何對待那些沒有能力回報你的人。

en: Action may not always bring happiness; but there is no happiness without action.
zh: 行動不一定會帶來幸福，但沒有行動就沒有幸福。

en: Never underestimate your power to change yourself!
zh: 永遠不要低估你改變自我的能力！

en: All things come to those who wait.
zh: 皇天不負苦心人。

en: It's not whether you get knocked down. It's whether you get up again.
zh: 你是否被打敗不是重點，重點是你是否能重振旗鼓。

en: Don't let the sadness of your past and the fear of your future ruin the happiness of your present.
zh: 別讓過去的悲催，或者未來的憂慮，毀掉當下的快樂。

en: You are never wrong to do the right thing. — The Intern
zh: 堅持做對的事，永遠不會錯。—高年級實習生

en: Whatever happens tomorrow, we had today. — One Day
zh: 無論明天發生什麼，我們都有當下。—真愛挑日子

en: Life was like a box of chocolates; you never know what you're going to get. — Forrest Gump
zh: 生命就像一盒巧克力，結果往往出人意料。—阿甘正傳

en: Yes, the past can hurt. But I think you can either run from it or learn from it. — Lion King
zh: 對，過去是痛楚的，但我認為你要麼可以逃避，要麼可以向它學習。—獅子王

en: Our job is improving the quality of life, not just delaying death. — Patch Adams
zh: 我們要做的是提升生活品質，而不是延緩死亡。—心靈點滴

en: Life's a little bit messy. We all make mistakes. No matter what type of animal you are, change starts with you. — Zootopia
zh: 生活總會有那麼點不順心，我們都會犯錯。天性如何並不重要，改變都由你開始。—動物方城市

en: Venture outside your comfort zone. The rewards are worth it. — Tangled
zh: 勇敢地踏出舒適圈去冒險吧！那些回報，絕對值得。—魔髮奇緣

en: It is not our abilities that show what we truly are, it is our choices. — Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
zh: 決定我們成為什麼樣人的，不是我們的能力，而是我們的選擇。—哈利・波特：消失的密室

en: To see the world, things dangerous to come to, to see behind walls, to draw closer, to find each other and to feel. That is the purpose of life. — The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
zh: 開拓視野，突破萬難，看見世界，貼近彼此，感受生活，這就是生活的目的。—白日夢冒險王

en: The journey is what brings us happiness, not the destination. — Peaceful Warrior
zh: 通往目標的過程帶給你快樂，最後結果並不重要。—深夜加油站遇見蘇格拉底

en: We're all traveling through time together, every day of our lives. All we can do is do our best to relish this remarkable ride. — About Time
zh: 我們生活的每一天，都在穿越時空，我們能做的就是盡其所能，珍惜這趟不凡的人生旅程。—真愛每一天

en: The very things that hold you down are going to lift you up. — Dumbo
zh: 讓你跌到谷底的事情，往往也是你重新站起的原因。—小飛象

en: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all. — Mulan
zh: 在逆境中綻放的花朵，是最珍貴也是最美的。—花木蘭

en: I never look back, darling. It distracts from the now. — The Incredibles
zh: 親愛的，我從不看過去，那會讓我無法專注於現在。—超人特攻隊

en: Who says my dreams have to stay dreams? — The Little Mermaid
zh: 誰說夢想只能是夢想呢？—小美人魚

en: Experience never goes out of fashion. — The Intern
zh: 經驗永遠不會過時。—高年級實習生

en: A good plan today is better than a perfect plan tomorrow. — Wag the Dog
zh: 今天的好計畫勝過明天的完美計畫。—搖尾狗

en: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift, that is why it's called present! — Kung Fu Panda
zh: 昨天已成為歷史，明天是未知的，而今天是上天賜予我們的禮物，這就是為什麼我們把它叫做現在！—功夫熊猫

en: Some mistakes just have greater consequences than others. But you don't have to let the result of one mistake be the thing that defines you.—Me Before You
zh: 有些錯誤代價特別大，但你不該讓一個過錯定義了自己。—我就要你好好的

en: Sometimes you gotta get through your fear to see the beauty on the other side.—The Good Dinosaur
zh: 有時你必須先克服恐懼才能看到另一端的美麗。—恐龍當家

en: There is no development physically or intellectually without effort, and effort means work.— Calvin Coolidge
zh: 沒有努力，就不會有身體或智能上的成長，而努力意謂幹活。— 卡爾文・柯立芝

en: Talent without working hard is nothing.— Cristiano Ronaldo
zh: 沒有努力，天份不代表什麼。—克里斯蒂亞諾・羅納度

en: Strength and growth come only through continuous effort and struggle.— Napoleon Hill
zh: 力量與成長只會來自持繼的努力與奮鬥。—拿破崙・希爾

en: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.— Stephen Hawking
zh: 不管生活多麼困難，總是有你可以做及取得成功的事。—史蒂芬・霍金

en: It's kind of fun to do the impossible.— Walt Disney
zh: 做不可能的事蠻有趣的。—華特・迪士尼

en: Be open to learning new lessons even if they contradict the lessons you learned yesterday.— Ellen Degeneres
zh: 敞開心胸學習新的東西，即使它與你昨天學到的互相抵觸。—艾倫・狄珍妮

en: I am always doing that which I cannot do, in order that I may learn how to do it.— Pablo Picasso
zh: 我總是做我不會的事，好讓我學習怎麼做。—畢卡索

en: Logic will get you from A to B. Imagination will take you everywhere.— Albert Einstein
zh: 邏輯會帶你從 A 點到達 B 點，想像力將把你帶到任何地方。—愛因斯坦

en: People who say that yesterday was better than today are ultimately devaluing their own existence.—Karl Lagerfeld.
zh: 說昨天比今天好的人，其實就是在貶低自己的存在。—卡爾拉格斐

en: That which doesn't kill me makes me stronger.—Friedrich Wilhelm Nietzsche
zh: 那些打不倒我的將使我更強大。—弗里德里希・威廉・尼采

en: He who has health has hope.
zh: 留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒

en: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
zh: 滾石不生苔

en: It never rains but pours.
zh: 禍不單行

en: Jump once but look twice.
zh: 三思而後行

en: Habit is second nature.
zh: 習慣成自然

en: Haste makes waste.
zh: 欲速則不達

en: Take the rough with the smooth.
zh: 隨遇而安

en: Do in Rome as the Ro man s do.
zh: 入境隨俗

en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
zh: 患難見真情

en: Courtesy costs nothing.
zh: 禮多人不怪

en: Birds of a feather flock together.
zh: 物以類聚

en: Faith will move mountains.
zh: 人定勝天。

en: Money makes the mare go.
zh: 有錢能使鬼推磨

en: Time flies like an arrow.
zh: 光陰似箭

en: Where there is smoke, there is fire.
zh: 無風不起浪

en: The pot calls the kettle black.
zh: 五十步笑百步

en: Monkey see, monkey do.
zh: 有樣學樣

en: Not getting what you want is sometimes a wonderful stroke of luck.
zh: 塞翁失馬，焉知非福

en: One generation plants the trees, another gets the shade.
zh: 前人種樹，後人乘涼

en: A word once spoken can never be recalled.
zh: 一言既出，駟馬難追。

en: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
zh: 情人眼裡出西施

en: Every dog has his day.
zh: 風水輪流轉

en: A miss is as good as a mile.
zh: 失之毫釐，差之千里

en: A little too late is much too late.
zh: 失之毫釐，差之千里

en: Bad news has wings.
zh: 好事不出門，壞事傳千里

en: It is better to die when life is a disgrace.
zh: 寧為玉碎，不為瓦全

en: Like knows like.
zh: 惺惺相惜

en: One eyewitness is better than ten hearsays.
zh: 百聞不如一見

en: Put the cart before the horse.
zh: 本末倒置

en: To err is human.
zh: 人非聖賢，孰能無過

en: Unpleasant advice is a good medicine.
zh: 忠言逆耳

en: Advice when most needed is least heeded.
zh: 忠言逆耳

en: Hard words break no bones.
zh: 忠言逆耳卻利於行

en: Give a dog a bad name and hang him.
zh: 人言可畏

en: A fox may grow gray, but never good.
zh: 江山易改，本性難移

en: Leopards cannot change their spots.
zh: 江山易改，本性難移

en: Business is business.
zh: 公事公辦

en: Children are what the mothers are.
zh: 耳濡目染，身教言傳

en: Great men's sons seldom do well.
zh: 富不過三代

en: Good medicine for health tastes bitter to the mouth.
zh: 良藥苦口利於病

en: Constant dripping wears away a stone.
zh: 滴水穿石，點石成金

en: Life is not a bed of roses.
zh: 人生無法事事如意

en: Well begun is half done.
zh: 好的開始是成功的一半

en: God's mill grinds slow but sure..
zh: 天網恢恢，疏而不漏

en: Justice has long arms.
zh: 天網恢恢，疏而不漏

en: It takes all sorts to make a world.
zh: 一種米養百種人

en: When one door shuts another opens.
zh: 天無絕人之路

en: Creep before you walk.
zh: 循序渐進

en: Words cut more than swords.
zh: 舌劍利於刀劍

en: Better rely on yourself than no others.
zh: 靠山山倒，靠自已最好

en: The climbing of a height begins at the base.
zh: 千里之行始於足下

en: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
zh: 施比受更有福

en: To entertain an angel unawares.
zh: 有眼不識泰山

en: Unity is strength.
zh: 團結就是力量

en: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
zh: 得寸進尺

en: A bad penny always comes back.
zh: 惡有惡報

en: One good turn deserves another.
zh: 善有善報

en: Virtue will have a good reward; vice will have an veil recompense.
zh: 善有善報，惡有惡報

en: It is as well to know which way the wind blows.
zh: 識時務者為俊傑

en: If the counsel be good, no matter who gave it.
zh: 從善如流

en: An uncut gem goes not sparkle.
zh: 玉不琢，不成器

en: Never try to prove what nobody doubts.
zh: 此地無銀三百兩

en: The higher the mountain, the greater descent.
zh: 爬得愈高，跌得愈深

en: A clear conscience is like a coat of mail.
zh: 平生不做虧心事，夜半敲門心不驚

en: A burnt child dreads the fire.
zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩

en: A coconut-shell full of water is an ocean to an ant
zh: 井底之蛙

en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
zh: 金窩銀窩不如自己狗窩

en: Call a spade a spade.
zh: 打開天窗說亮話

en: Deeds are better than words.
zh: 坐而言不如起而行

en: Every family has a skeleton in the cupboard.
zh: 家家本難唸的經

en: Fields have eyes, and woods have ears.
zh: 隔牆有耳

en: Filial piety is the foundation of family discipline.
zh: 孝順為齊家之本

en: Fine words butter no parsnips
zh: 畫餅充飢

en: Love and blindness are twin sisters.
zh: 愛情是盲目的

en: He knows most who speaks least.
zh: 大智若愚

en: If a man takes no thoughts about what is distant, sorrow is surely near at hand.
zh: 人無遠慮，必有近憂

en: If the family lives in harmony, all affairs will prosper.
zh: 家和萬事興

en: If you have tasted the bitterest of the bitter, you will become the greatest of the great.
zh: 吃得苦中苦方為人上人

en: Pride hurts, modesty benefits.
zh: 謙受益，滿招損

en: Kind hearts are soonest wronged.
zh: 人善被人欺

en: Learning is like rowing upstream, not to advance is to drop back
zh: 學習之道不進則退

en: Learning without thinking is vain; thinking without learning is perilous.
zh: 學而不思則罔，思而不學則殆

en: Least said, soonest mended.
zh: 言多必失

en: Many learn to be wise by the folly of others.
zh: 見不賢內自省

en: Meeting is the beginning of parting.
zh: 天下無不散的宴席

en: Men are blind in their own cause.
zh: 當局者迷

en: Never do things by halves.
zh: 絕對不要半途而廢

en: Never judge by appearance.
zh: 不要以貌取人

en: No gains without pains.
zh: 沒有不勞而獲的事

en: A honey tongue, a heart of gall.
zh: 笑裏藏刀

en: A guilty conscience needs no accuser.
zh: 作賊心虛

en: All are not thieves that dogs bark at
zh: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量

en: Better breeding than birth.
zh: 養育之恩大於生育

en: Better lose the saddle than the horse.
zh: 兩者權衡取其輕

en: Share and share alike.
zh: 有福同享，有難同當

en: If the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
zh: 無濟於事

en: Don't catch at the shadow and lose the substance.
zh: 不要捨本逐末

en: It is easy to be wise after the event.
zh: 不經一事，不長一智

en: Distant kinsmen mean less than close neighbors.
zh: 遠親不如近鄰

en: Saying is one thing and doing another.
zh: 說是一回事，做是另外一回事

en: It is enough to show a whip to a beaten dog.
zh: 驚弓之鳥

en: You see a man's face but not his heart.
zh: 知人知面不知心

en: A bad workman quarrels with his tools.
zh: 拙匠常怪其器不精。

en: A crowd is not company.
zh: 群眾非良伴。

en: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
zh: 溺水胡抓草，病急亂投醫。

en: A friend to everybody is a friend to nobody.
zh: 鄉愿德之賊。

en: After a storm comes a calm.
zh: 暴風雨後有寧靜。雨過天青，否極泰來。

en: A liar is not believed when he speaks the truth.
zh: 無人相信善謊者的真心話。

en: All good things come to an end.
zh: 天下無不散的筵席。

en: All roads lead to Rome.
zh: 條條大路通羅馬。

en: A man is known by the company he keeps.
zh: 什麼人交什麼朋友。觀其友，知其人。

en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
zh: 一天一個蘋果，醫生遠離我。

en: April showers bring May flowers.
zh: 飲水思源。

en: A stitch in time saves nine.
zh: 及時行事，事半功倍。 防微杜漸。

en: A storm in a teacup.
zh: 小題大做 。大驚小怪。

en: As a man sows, so he shall reap.
zh: 種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆。 善有善報，惡有惡報。

en: A clean hand wants no washing.
zh: 清者自清，濁者自濁。身正不怕影子斜。

en: A young idler, an old beggar.
zh: 少壯不努力，老大徒傷悲。

en: An ass in Germany is a professor in Rome.
zh: 他山之石可以攻錯。

en: A clear conscience is a soft pillow.
zh: 平生不做虧心事，夜半敲門心不驚。

en: As a man makes his bed so must he lie.
zh: 自做自受。

en: A little bird wants but a little nest.
zh: 人窮志短。

en: Ambition can creep as well as soar.
zh: 大丈夫能屈能伸。

en: All for one, one for all.
zh: 人人為我，我為人人。

en: Accidents will happen.
zh: 天有不測風雲，人有旦夕禍福。

en: All's well that ends well.
zh: 結尾好的事就是好事。

en: A penny at a pinch is worth a pound.
zh: 緊要關頭，小錢當大錢用。

en: A watched pot never boils.
zh: 心急水不沸，欲速則不達。

en: A baited cat may grow as fierce as a lion.
zh: 狗急跳牆。

en: A cock is bold on his own dunghill.
zh: 狗仗人勢。夜郎自大。

en: A crooked stick will have a crooked shadow.
zh: 上樑不正下樑歪，中樑不正倒下來。

en: A deceitful peace is more hurtful than an open war.
zh: 明槍易躲，暗箭難防。

en: A fond mother produced mischief.
zh: 牛要耕田馬要騎，孩子不打變調皮。

en: A fool may give a wise man counsel.
zh: 智者千慮必有一失，愚者千慮必有一得。

en: A good name is sooner lost than won.
zh: 學壞容易學好難。

en: A good shift may serve long, but it will not serve ever.
zh: 騙人一時，騙不了一世。

en: A hedge between keeps friendship green.
zh: 君子之交淡如水，小人之交甜如蜜。

en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
zh: 登高必自卑，行遠必自邇。

en: A little fire burns up a great deal of corn.
zh: 星星之火可以燎原。

en: A little gall spoils a great deal of honey.
zh: 一粒老鼠屎，壞了一鍋粥。

en: A little leak will sink a great ship.
zh: 牽一髮而動全身。千丈之堤潰於蟻穴。

en: A little neglect may breed great mischief.
zh: 一失足成千古恨，再回頭已百年身。

en: A man among children will be long a child.
zh: 近朱者赤，近墨者黑。

en: A man apt to promise is apt to forget.
zh: 輕諾者，信必寡。

en: A man at five may be a fool at fifteen.
zh: 小時了了，大未必佳。

en: A man is one who is faithful to his word.
zh: 一言九鼎。君子一言，駟馬難追。

en: A man should take as companion one older than himself.
zh: 結交須勝己，似我不如無。

en: A near neighbor is better than a distant cousin.
zh: 遠親不如近鄰。

en: A slow fire makes sweet malt.
zh: 慢工出細活。事緩則圓。

en: A thing begun is half done.
zh: 萬事起頭難。

en: After delay comes a let.
zh: 福無雙至，禍不單行。 屋漏偏逢連夜雨，船破又遇對頭風。

en: After supper walk a mile.
zh: 飯後三百步，不用開藥鋪。

en: All cry and no wool.
zh: 只聽樓梯響，不見人下來。

en: All is not gold that glitters.
zh: 不是會亮的就是金子。 裡頭一包蔥，外頭裝相公。

en: All lay loads on a willing horse.
zh: 能者多勞。人善被人欺，馬善被人騎。

en: All the winning is in the first buying.
zh: 先下手為強。

en: All things are easy that are done willingly.
zh: 天下無難事，只要有心人。

en: An empty sack cannot stand upright.
zh: 人是鐵，飯是鋼，三日不吃餓到慌。

en: An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
zh: 一報還一報。以牙還牙。

en: An ill tongue may do much.
zh: 話到口邊留半句，理從是處讓三分。 話多不如話少，多易錯，少易好。 讒言入耳三冬暖，惡語傷人六月寒。

en: An old man's sayings are seldom untrue.
zh: 不聽老人言，吃虧在眼前。

en: Anybody can make mistake.
zh: 人非聖賢，孰能無過。

en: At a great bargain, make a pause.
zh: 便宜無好貨，好貨不便宜。

en: Avoid evil and it will avoid you.
zh: 天下本無事，庸人自擾之。

en: A little learning is a dangerous thing.
zh: 一知半解最危險。淺學誤人。

en: A little pot is soon hot.
zh: 小人易怒。

en: A barking dog never bites.
zh: 刀子嘴豆腐心。

en: A great man cannot brook a rival.
zh: 一國無二主，一山無二虎。

en: A man's reach should exceed his grasp.
zh: 量力而為。

en: A new broom sweeps clean.
zh: 新官上任三把火。

en: A penny saved is a penny earned (gained).
zh: 省一文就是賺一文。

en: A straw shows which way the wind blows.
zh: 觀微知著。一葉知秋。

en: All his geese are swans.
zh: 敝帚自珍。

en: All is fish that comes to my net.
zh: 來者不拒。

en: All his swans are geese.
zh: 諾言成空談。希望成泡影。

en: A candle lights others and consumes itself.
zh: 燃燒自己，照亮別人。

en: A common danger causes common action.
zh: 同仇敵愾。

en: A constant guest is never welcome.
zh: 久住非佳賓，常來不歡迎。

en: A disease known is half cured.
zh: 病情確診斷，治病好一半。

en: A good beginning makes a good ending.
zh: 善始者必善其終。

en: A hero is known in the time of misfortune.
zh: 時勢造英雄。

en: A liar is worse than a thief.
zh: 說謊比偷竊更可惡。

en: A little is better than none.
zh: 聊勝於無。

en: All are not saints that go to church.
zh: 去做禮拜者，未必皆聖人。

en: All cats love fish but fear to wet their paws.
zh: 貓都愛吃魚，卻怕爪弄濕。

en: All is fair in war.
zh: 兵不厭詐。

en: A man can't whistle and drink at the same time.
zh: 一心不能二用。

en: Ambition never dies until there is no way out.
zh: 不到黃河心不死。

en: Appearances are deceitful.
zh: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量。

en: A secret between more than two is no secret.
zh: 兩人以上知道的秘密就不算秘密。

en: A stumble may prevent a fall.
zh: 小懲大誡。

en: A willful man will have his way.
zh: 有志者事竟成。

en: A wise man cares not for what he can't have.
zh: 智者不作非分之想。

en: A wise man will make tools of what comes to hand.
zh: 聰明人能隨機應變。

en: A word is enough to the wise.
zh: 對明智者一言已足。

en: A good book is the purest essence of a human soul.
zh: 好書是人類靈魂最純靜的精髓。

en: A man may lose more in an hour than he can get in seven.
zh: 易失難得。

en: A tale never loses in the telling.
zh: 加油添醋。

en: All gains are made at some sacrifice.
zh: 一切收穫都來自犧牲。

en: All is not lost that's in peril.
zh: 危險不等於完蛋。

en: A hard beginning makes a good ending.
zh: 先苦後甘。

en: All things are difficult before they are easy.
zh: 萬事起頭難。

en: A lion at home, a mouse abroad.
zh: 在家一條龍，出外一條蟲。

en: A thorn in one's side.
zh: 眼中釘，肉中刺。

en: Apples of gold in pictures of silver.
zh: 錦上添花。
